scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:server: npm --workspace=@drafter/shared run build && npm --workspace=@drafter/server run build
scripts.build:extension: npm --workspace=@drafter/shared run build && npm --workspace=@drafter/extension run build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:server
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
